timeline.body: What is the reason that you moved the actual conversion out of `convert`?

reply.body: I'm not entirely sure as it's been a long time since I made this change, but I think the reason was that I needed to have the union of all the the inputs to compute the filters. Options with `allowMultiple = true` will always concatenate the list of converted values for each `input`, that is why it wasn't possible to add an event back in: once an `input` was converted to filter an EventKind, a subsequent `input` could not remove the filter from the accumulator. I found it easier to just move the conversion outside, after all the strings have been accumulated.

@meisterT Rebased and moved all the conversions back into the converter. Need to store two separate lists of events (removed and added) thou. Let me know if there is something I'm missing to avoid this.
